commands

常用命令:

# 查看所有主机
ansible --list-hosts all

# 第一次执行, 加 ssh-extra-args 获取 Host Key
# [ -e ${HOME}/.ssh/known_hosts ] && mv ${HOME}/.ssh/{known_hosts,known_hosts_$(date +%s)}
rm -fv ${HOME}/.ssh/known_hosts
ansible --ssh-extra-args='-o StrictHostKeyChecking=no' -m ping all

# 有时需要按 hosts 列表顺序执行命令, 可以使用 -f --forks 参数, 默认是 10, 设置为 1, 即只产生1个线程
ansible -f 1 -m shell -a 'echo ok' all

# -l 指定服务器
ansible -l '10.25.109.241:10.25.109.242:10.25.109.243' -m shell -a 'echo ok' centos

# 检查主机存活状态
ansible -m ping centos

# 系统相关
ansible -m shell -a 'uptime' centos
ansible -m shell -a 'sudo netstat -ntulap' centos
ansible -m shell -a 'lsb_release -d' centos

# 时间
# NTP Server: https://www.ntppool.org/zh/use.html
ansible -m shell -a 'date' centos
ansible -m shell -a 'sudo /usr/sbin/ntpdate 0.pool.ntp.org' centos
ansible -m shell -a 'sudo hwclock -w' centos

# 内核相关
ansible -m shell -a 'sudo uname -r' centos
ansible -m shell -a 'rpm -qa | grep ^kernel | sort' centos

# 查找并删除无效链接
ansible -m shell -a 'sudo find -L /usr -type l' centos
ansible -m shell -a 'sudo find -L /usr -type l | xargs sudo rm -f' centos

# Yum 相关
ansible -m synchronize -a 'src=https://documents.v2ep.com/etc/yum.repos.d/ dest=/etc/yum.repos.d/ delete=yes recursive=yes' centos
ansible -m shell -a 'sudo yum clean all' centos
ansible -m shell -a 'sudo yum -y update' centos

# 批量重启, 慎用!!
# ansible -m shell -a 'sudo systemctl reboot' centos

# 清除登陆提示
ansible -m shell -a ': > /etc/motd' all

synchronize

参考文档: https://docs.ansible.com/ansible/2.9/modules/synchronize_module.html

参考命令:

# 本地同步到远程: mode=push (默认)
ansible -m synchronize -a 'src=https://documents.v2ep.com/tmp/xxx.sh dest=/tmp/' test

# 远程同步到本地: mode=pull
ansible -m synchronize -a 'src=https://documents.v2ep.com/tmp/xxx.sh dest=/tmp/ mode=pull' test

# 删除文件
ansible -m synchronize -a 'src=https://documents.v2ep.com/etc/yum.repos.d/ dest=/etc/yum.repos.d/ delete=yes recursive=yes' test
